# A disposal that pays a bank charge and leaves an exchange difference, with
# nothing saying which split is which.
#
# The shape a real book arrives in, and the reason an account has to be named
# rather than guessed at. 1,000.00 USD costing 1,300.00 CAD are sold: 1,390.00
# reaches the Canadian bank, 10.00 goes to the bank's charge, and the 100.00
# between what the dollars cost and the 1,400.00 they fetched is the difference.
#
#     cost          1,300.00
#     fetched       1,400.00   =  1,390.00 banked + 10.00 charged
#     difference      100.00
#
# Both the charge and the difference sit on accounts a difference can land on —
# one an expense, one an income — so neither the amounts nor the account types
# tell them apart. `--fx-gain-account "Income:FX Gain"` states which one is the
# difference, and the 10.00 charge must stay out of the figure.
#
# `{usd_basis}` is the guid of the purchase's cost basis, read from
# `fx-balances` after the first import.
2026-01-01 open Expenses
	type: "Expense"
	placeholder: #True
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Expenses:Bank charges
	type: "Expense"
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"

2026-06-01 * "Sell every dollar at 1.40, less the bank's charge"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Assets:USD Bank -1000.00 USD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
		share_price: "13/10"
		value: "-1300.00"
		cost_basis_split_guid: "{usd_basis}"
	Assets:CAD Bank 1390.00 CAD
	Expenses:Bank charges 10.00 CAD
	Income:FX Gain -100.00 CAD
